SEO_TITLE: DocSend Lite — password-protected pitch deck links with view tracking
SEO_DESCRIPTION: Upload a PDF, get a shareable link with password gate, expiry, and view analytics. DocSend / Papermark alternative for founders and freelancers. Free tier ships 3 docs — no signup on free.
SEO_KEYWORDS: docsend alternative, papermark alternative, pitch deck link, pdf password link, share pdf tracking, secure pdf sharing, pdf view analytics
HERO_HEADLINE: Send your pitch deck like a pro, without paying DocSend.
HERO_SUBHEAD: Upload PDF → get a shareable link with password + expiry + view analytics. Papermark alternative, MIT-licensed. Free tier is 3 docs — no signup.
HERO_MICRO_PROOF: Renders in-browser via pdf.js. Password check is client-side + server-side (Pro). View tracking via a single beacon — no third-party trackers.
PROBLEM_STATEMENT: DocSend is $15-45/month. Papermark is the OSS answer but AGPL — you can't fork it into a client project without exposing your whole stack. Cloud storage links leak (no expiry, no password, no analytics). DocSend Lite is a simple upload → link → password + expiry + view counter. MIT license, self-hostable, no seat pricing.
FEATURE_1_BODY: Every share link ships with an optional password (SHA-256 gated) and an expiry timestamp. Set once, sleep at night.
FEATURE_2_BODY: Per-link: total views, unique viewers (IP-hashed), pages viewed, time on doc. No creepy fingerprinting — just what a founder actually needs before a follow-up email.
FEATURE_3_BODY: Whole stack is pdf.js + a single Cloudflare Pages Function + KV. Runs on Cloudflare free tier for 100k views/month. Fork it, host it on your own subdomain, own your data.
PRICING_FREE_BULLETS:
• 3 shared docs (localStorage)
  • Password gate
  • 7-day expiry
  • Basic view counter
PRICING_PRO_BULLETS:
• Unlimited docs
  • Custom expiry (up to 90 days)
  • Per-page analytics + time on doc
  • Email capture gate (optional)
  • Custom subdomain
  • Team sharing
FAQ_1_A: As secure as any client-side gated system. Password is checked before the PDF loads; the file itself lives on Cloudflare R2 (Pro) or your own drive (Free — you paste a URL). This is not DoD-grade — it's a friction gate that stops link-forwarding and lets you see who opened what. For real secrets use a data room like Notarize / Dropbox Docsend Enterprise / Datasite.
FAQ_2_A: Papermark is excellent — but it's AGPL. If you fork or self-host it into a commercial product, you inherit AGPL obligations for your entire stack. DocSend Lite is MIT. Fork freely, use inside anything.
FAQ_3_Q: How do view analytics work without tracking cookies?
FAQ_3_A: One beacon per view — POST /api/v1/view with `{ docId, page, elapsed_ms }`. IP is one-way hashed with a per-doc salt. Free tier stores in localStorage (single-device view). Pro stores in Cloudflare KV / D1 for cross-device dashboards.
FAQ_4_A: Yes. `git clone`, `wrangler pages deploy`, done. The Pages Function needs one KV namespace binding. Total infra cost on Cloudflare's free tier is $0 for the first 100k monthly views.
